feeds.title: Energy Insights Blog
feeds.description: Energy Insights provides you with the content you need to understand the market dynamics and technological changes that are shaping the energy sector.

feeds.title: Energy Today
feeds.description: Energy Today provides a positive platform for the petroleum, gas, and future fuels industries, allowing in-depth coverage into new projects, integrity and maintenance, technology, and people who power this great sector. Energy Today also includes the PPO Projects database which has cemented its place as the leading source of project updates.

feeds.title: Petroleum Exploration Society of Australia
feeds.description: The Petroleum Exploration Society of Australia (PESA) is a national organisation representing the interests of all professionals and practitioners in the upstream petroleum industry. PESA is a non-profit association of individuals involved in the energy geosciences industry. We present views and discuss technical and professional matters relating to the energy geosciences industry.

feeds.title: Carnarvon Energy Ltd
feeds.description: Get the latest first-hand updates addressed directly to shareholders. Incorporated in 1983 as an oil and gas explorer focused on the Carnarvon basin offshore Western Australia, the Company expanded internationally the 1990s and early 2000s, with assets and operations in Papua New Guinea, Indonesia and Thailand.

feeds.title: Energy Magazine
feeds.description: Get the latest and breaking news from Australia's gas industry, exploring the projects, developments and people that make the energy industry tick. Energy has a strong focus on helping the industry to deal with some of the challenges it is currently facing. We look at the policies and politics affecting the industry; but we always place the emphasis on outcomes rather than political point-scoring.

feeds.title: The Australian Pipeliner
feeds.description: The Australian Pipeliner is the official magazine of the Australian Pipelines and Gas Association (APGA) and the leading media brand for the sector. The publication covers everything from upstream gas exploration and facilities, to construction and maintenance of hydrocarbon transmission pipelines and water pipelines.

feeds.title: Bossong Engineering Blog
feeds.description: The Bossong Engineering blog is a source of information to provide you with the latest news and tips for a range of industries and engineering services. Bossong Engineering was established in 1988 by Steve and Janice Bossong to service the Australian and global markets with advanced manufacturing systems. A proud second generation family business, the company is now being led into the future by sons Paul and Mark Bossong.

feeds.title: Patch Personnel Blog
feeds.description: To learn more about the Oil, Gas, Engineering and Mining industry, take a look at our insights with posts loaded to our latest blog. Patch Personnel was formed by a group of successful recruitment professionals and industry leaders to ensure the delivery of a comprehensive and high-quality range of personnel services to the Oil and Gas, Engineering and Construction sectors.

feeds.title: Crude Oil Peak
feeds.description: This site is about monitoring the global crude oil peak and its impact on the economy, peaking of oil production in various countries, in particular those with geo-political importance, oil-dependent infrastructure like motorways and airports, links between peak oil and the debt problem and inter-dependencies with global warming (CO2 debt).

feeds.title: Benzoil Blog
feeds.description: Innovative solutions for waste management, resource recovery, and surplus & disposal. Benzoil delivers waste and resource recovery solutions for industry. Drawing from a deeply connected network and strategic partnerships we uncover best practice outcomes for waste and surplus material.
